_about.source: Real TUIs run in a 100x30 pty (env scrubbed to HOME/PATH/TERM/LANG), every output byte recorded, then rendered through the daemon's own generateTextSnapshot. Captured 2026-09-28. Rows trimmed to the bottom of the grid; status-line, account, banner and path rows removed.
